One crafting recipe inside a Template:Tl with type=craft. The result is on top and the materials are under it, so several recipes fit in a small space (they sit in columns on wide screens).

Usage 

{{LootRecipe
|result=9002381
|m1=42572
|m2=42573
|m3=9002382
}}

result is the item that is made. m1 to m6 are the materials, and a1 to a6 are their amounts (1 if left out). rgrade and g1 to g6 are optional grades of the result and the materials (for example Celestial). tag is an optional word on the result, for example Craftable.

A crafting recipe for a loot group, with the result on top and the materials under it.
